pages.text: Cataclysm adds massive T3–$(t4)T4$(end) dungeon structures with ultra-boss encounters and unique materials.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Cataclysm is the hardest $(t3)T3$(end) content. Five ultra-bosses (Netherite Monstrosity, Ignis, The $(item)Harbinger$(/item), The Leviathan, Maledictus) each in enormous purpose-built structures.$(br2)$(bold)Loot:$(/bold) Cataclysm structures have some of the highest token drop rates in T3. Boss materials from Cataclysm bosses are among the best $(t3)T3$(end) crafting components.

$(bold)Prep requirement:$(/bold) Full terrasteel or enderium gear is the minimum recommended for Cataclysm boss attempts. Maledictus and The $(item)Harbinger$(/item) in particular are calibrated for well-geared $(t3)T3$(end) players.$(br2)$(bold)Unique weapons:$(/bold) 8 $(thing)Simply Swords$(/thing) uniques drop from Cataclysm bosses — the most of any single mod.

$(bold)No guide book.$(/bold) Cataclysm is boss-focused — documentation comes from fighting. Each boss drops a $(bold)Trophy$(/bold) that can be placed for display. JEI covers all weapon and armor recipes unlocked by boss materials.
